title: Social / Three content types
slide_intent: Adapt a shared visual vocabulary to different kinds of posts so recognition does not depend on repeating one template.
strategic_value: A common handle treatment and purple-linked graphic language can connect Twitch’s food, creator and game posts.
demonstration: Three social-post mockups pair an orange text-led post, a creator portrait under the Twitch signature, and a game-image post with purple copy.
practical_value: Compare what stays consistent when text, people or game content becomes the main subject.

content_islands.name: Three posts
content_islands.spec: Align three white social frames, each retaining its account header and familiar footer controls.

content_islands.name: Content variation
content_islands.spec: Use large copy at left, creator portrait and signature in the center, and game content with a headline at right.

reference_purposes.Application: The three mockups apply the identity to distinct social content formats.
